defects: The conclusion integrates over the finite interval x₀..(x₀+a) (a proper/interval integral) rather than over the unbounded ray Ioi a as specified by the informal statement ('integral over a ray') and the gold statement — this changes the theorem to a different, though related, proposition (a standard integral-test bound on [a,b] rather than a bound by the tail integral to infinity).
Drops the integrability hypothesis 'IntegrableOn f (Ioi a)' entirely, which gold requires since its conclusion involves integrating over the infinite ray.

Weakens the nonnegativity hypothesis from holding on the whole ray Ioi a (needed in gold so the integral over [a,b] can be compared to the integral over all of Ioi a) to holding only on the finite interval Icc x₀ (x₀+a).
